foundations.title: Foundations (F)
foundations.description: Students build a foundation for achieving dynamic literacy practices to aid reading comprehension.

phonological_awareness.title: Phonological Awareness
phonological_awareness.description: Students develop the ability to identify and produce the sound structures of spoken language and how they can be divided into smaller components and manipulated.

rhyme.title: Rhyme
rhyme.description: Identify and produce rhyme in spoken language and oral texts.

sub_standards.a: Identify and pair words that rhyme in spoken language, distinguishing them from those that do not.

words_sentences.title: Words & Sentences
words_sentences.description: Recognize the basic relationships that exist between words and sentences.

sub_standards.a: Know words are put together to make sentences, and sentences communicate complete thoughts.
sub_standards.b: Segment phrases and sentences into words.
sub_standards.c: Know that sounds are put together to make words and that words have distinct meanings.

compound_words.title: Compound Words
compound_words.description: Identify and manipulate separate words in compound words.

sub_standards.a: Blend and segment separate words in spoken compound words.
sub_standards.b: Add, delete, and substitute single words in spoken compound words.

syllables.title: Syllables
syllables.description: Identify and manipulate syllables in spoken words.

sub_standards.a: Know that syllables are word parts with one vowel sound.
sub_standards.b: Count and pronounce syllables in single and multisyllabic spoken words.
sub_standards.c: Blend and segment syllables in spoken words.

onsets_rimes.title: Onsets & Rimes
onsets_rimes.description: Blend and segment onsets and rimes in spoken words.

sub_standards.a: Blend onsets and rimes of spoken one-syllable words.
sub_standards.b: Segment onsets and rimes of spoken one-syllable words.

phonemic_awareness.title: Phonemic Awareness
phonemic_awareness.description: Identify and manipulate the individual sounds in spoken words.

sub_standards.a: Isolate and pronounce initial, final, and then medial sounds in spoken words with three phonemes.
sub_standards.b: Identify short and long vowel sounds in spoken one-syllable words.
sub_standards.c: Blend, count, and segment up to three phonemes in spoken one-syllable words.
sub_standards.d: Add, delete, and substitute phonemes in spoken one-syllable words with up to three phonemes.

concepts_of_print.title: Concepts of Print
concepts_of_print.description: Students develop the awareness that written language carries meaning and that certain features of print ensure that texts are understood.

sub_standards.a: Recognize that texts and images represent objects and ideas, have meaning, and convey messages.
sub_standards.b: Recognize and interpret print messages in the environment, such as labels and signs.
sub_standards.c: Distinguish between letters, words, digits, and graphics.

book_orientation.title: Book Orientation & Directionality of Print Texts
book_orientation.description: Understand the conventional layout of books and how to maneuver them.

sub_standards.a: Hold books upright and begin reading at the front.
sub_standards.b: Follow text from top to bottom, left to right, and turn pages from right to left.
sub_standards.c: Identify the front and back covers of books and their basic elements: titles, author names, illustrator names, and graphics.

mechanics_of_print.title: Mechanics of Print Texts
mechanics_of_print.description: Build a knowledge base of print conventions.

sub_standards.a: Recognize that written words are made up of individual letters.
sub_standards.b: Recognize that words are separated by spaces.
sub_standards.c: Understand that sentences begin with capital letters and end with punctuation to indicate the end of a sentence.

sub_standards.a: Recite the letters of the alphabet in order.
sub_standards.b: Name and identify each uppercase and lowercase letter in random order.
